summary:
The follow-up adds an optional occupation field throughout employee contracts, persistence adapters, API models, edit and batch forms, and derived workspace views.
- Adds the employee occupation database column and migration.
- Propagates occupation through repositories, services, contracts, and UI models.
- Adds validation, persistence, rendering, and form-resynchronization coverage.
confidenceReasoning:
The PR is not yet safe to merge because an employee update can still commit before a later workplace mutation fails, leaving persisted and displayed state inconsistent.

The employee editor still performs the base employee update before the workplace update and does not resynchronize same-employee form state when the latter rejects, so the previously reported partial-save failure remains reachable.
